blurb: Randon Aviation provides flight training courses including Private Pilot Certification, Instrument Rating, Commercial Pilot Certification, and Certified Flight Instructor training. The school offers an accelerated program designed for students aiming for airline careers. Training includes classroom instruction, complex flight training, and mentorship with experienced instructors.
